purpose: Three original male whole-portrait explorations from Guigu visual inspiration, retaining project material and frame

specs.name: 斜掠额发·清锐少侠
specs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Draw ONE original handsome Chinese male cultivator portrait for OUR existing game, exploring a genuinely different male face and hairstyle.
REFERENCE ROLES ARE CRITICAL:
Image1 is a Tale of Immortal / 鬼谷八荒 screenshot, used ONLY as loose inspiration for readable brow/eye character and hair silhouette. Do not copy its exact character, UI, costume, body pose, flat cel coloring or bold black outlines.
Image2 is OUR USER-APPROVED PROJECT ART MASTER. It determines the exact PAINTING STYLE, warm pale skin palette, charcoal-black hair material, body/canvas composition and compatible skull/neck frame. It is NOT an identity that must be preserved. Invent the variant's own attractive eyes, brows, nose and mouth as described below, rather than redrawing the project master face with a different wig.

PAINT QUALITY AND MATERIALS: match image2's delicate semi-realistic Chinese gongbi / soft ink-and-wash finish, muted warm ivory paper, fine natural soft hair strands, deep matte warm charcoal-black masses and weak warmgray highlights. Keep the SAME warm light ivory-peach skin family on face, ears and neck. No bleached/pink/tan skin, gray/silver shiny hair, black cartoon outlines, pore detail, plastic polish or heavy makeup. Subtly masculine coherent face with good normal anatomy and restrained natural shading. All features are painted together as ONE harmonious finished portrait.
Eyes must remain natural small-to-medium male eyes with normal-size brown irises partly covered by upper lids, short sparse lashes and fine light lid strokes. Differences should come from eye opening, inner/outer corner flow, brow construction and nose/lip morphology, not bigger eyes, heavy eyeliner, angry squints or huge irises. No thick lipstick or pout.

COMPOSITION LOCK: same whole1024x1536 canvas and head/neck size as image2. Straight frontal upper body down to tied waist, eyes directly at viewer, no turn/tilt or crossed-arm pose. Centerline aboutx513–514, eyes around(462,365)/(566,365), brow bandy340–350, nosearound(517,444), lipsaround(516,477), chinabout(513,544), central hairline near(514,268), earsy350–440. Preserve the existing rounded skull, jaw/ears and neck silhouette and collar contact; vary internal feature shapes rather than enlarging or shifting the face. Neck at y530 x428–601,y550 x426–603,y580 x421–608; collar rootsaround(433,545)/(599,545), V near(532,684), shouldersabouty718, sashabouty1250. Hair can change but stays within canvas and normal restrained volume. No guide marks.
Keep image2's same deep muted jade-green robe, ivory crossed inner collar, pale-gold botanical/cloud embroidery, folds and cloth sash. Plain warm ivory paper background. No UI, text, labels, panels, extra people, weapons, armor, black cloak or conspicuous crown.

VARIANT DESIGN:
A bright clear handsome young hero, age24, naturally confident and lively rather than the master's uniformly half-lidded composure. Distinct lightly angled sword brows made of separated fine hairs: clear gentle brow peak, thin tapering ends. Almond/phoenix eyes with a clearer alert opening, slightly lifted outer corners and clean soft lower lids; a little sharper inner corner, regular-sized iris. A refined narrower straight nose, delicately readable alae, balanced slim lips with a very subtle relaxed upward corner. Keep a handsome masculine facial balance.
Inspired by image1's sweep and broken forelocks, design a diagonally swept FRONT FRINGE with natural overlapping short/medium tapered locks, irregular open gaps showing forehead, swept from image-left toward image-right. The longest locks stop beside the outer eye or temple and do not cover either pupil. Vary lock lengths and taper softly; do not make a straight bowl cut, a dense helmet, geometric stiff triangles or two cheek curtains. Gather posterior hair into a small high half-knot with a simple dark cord; back hair falls in a narrow long bundle behind the shoulder. Keep forehead strand texture as delicate and matte as image2. Hair and the clearly brighter-shaped brows/eyes must distinguish this man from the project master and the previous same-face variations.
